paragraphs.en: 07/23/2026: 📣 We released VibeASR.cpp — a real-time multilingual ASR inference engine on CPU using BitNet I2_S quantization, achieving RTF < 1 with very few threads on x86 (AVX2) and ARM (NEON) platforms. [ Code ] [ Models ] [ Report ]

paragraphs.en: 07/20/2026: 📣 We released BitNet-embedding-0.6B and BitNet-embedding-270M on Hugging Face — the first 1-bit embedding models that deliver competitive embedding quality with significantly faster inference on CPUs.
paragraphs.zh: 07/20/2026: 📣 我们在 Hugging Face 上发布了 BitNet-embedding-0.6B 和 BitNet-embedding-270M —— 首批 1 位嵌入模型，在提供具有竞争力的嵌入质量的同时，在 CPU 上实现显著更快的推理速度。

paragraphs.en: 07/16/2026: 📣 Released BitNet Embeddings 0.6B/270M: I2_S Conversion and Inference Optimization — detailed guide for converting and running BitNet embedding models with optimized I2_S kernels.
paragraphs.zh: 07/16/2026: 📣 发布 BitNet 嵌入模型 0.6B/270M：I2_S 转换与推理优化 — 详细的转换与运行指南，帮助您使用经过优化的 I2_S 内核运行 BitNet 嵌入模型。

paragraphs.en: 01/15/2026: 📣 Released BitNet CPU Inference Optimization — parallel kernel implementations with configurable tiling and embedding quantization support, achieving 1.15x to 2.1x additional speedup over the original implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 01/15/2026: 📣 发布 BitNet CPU 推理优化——支持可配置分块（tiling）与嵌入量化的并行内核实现，相比原实现额外获得 1.15 倍至 2.1 倍的加速。

paragraphs.en: 05/20/2025: 📣 Released BitNet Official GPU inference kernel — extending 1-bit inference beyond CPUs.
paragraphs.zh: 05/20/2025：📣 发布 BitNet 官方 GPU 推理内核——将 1-bit 推理扩展到 CPU 之外。

paragraphs.en: 04/14/2025: 📣 Released BitNet Official 2B Parameter Model on Hugging Face — the first official BitNet b1.58 model trained with 4T tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 04/14/2025: 📣 在 Hugging Face 上发布 BitNet 官方 2B 参数模型——这是首个使用 4T tokens 训练的官方 BitNet b1.58 模型。

paragraphs.zh: 02/18/2025：📑 Bitnet.cpp：面向三值大语言模型的高效边缘推理 —— 关于 bitnet.cpp 架构与设计的系统级论文。

paragraphs.en: bitnet.cpp is the official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs (e.g., BitNet b1.58). It offers a suite of optimized kernels that support fast and lossless inference of 1.58-bit models on CPU and GPU (NPU support coming next).
paragraphs.zh: bitnet.cpp 是 1-bit 大语言模型（例如 BitNet b1.58）的官方推理框架。 它提供了一套优化的内核，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上对 1.58-bit 模型进行快速且无损的推理（NPU 支持即将推出）。

sents.en: bitnet.cpp is the official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs (e.g., BitNet b1.58).
sents.zh: bitnet.cpp 是 1-bit 大语言模型（例如 BitNet b1.58）的官方推理框架。

sents.en: It offers a suite of optimized kernels that support fast and lossless inference of 1.58-bit models on CPU and GPU (NPU support coming next).
sents.zh: 它提供了一套优化的内核，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上对 1.58-bit 模型进行快速且无损的推理（NPU 支持即将推出）。

paragraphs.en: Try it out via this online demo , or build and run it on your own CPU or GPU .
paragraphs.zh: 通过这个在线演示试用，或者在你自己的 CPU 或 GPU 上构建并运行它。

paragraphs.en: bitnet.cpp achieves speedups of 1.37x to 5.07x on ARM CPUs, with larger models experiencing greater performance gains. Additionally, it reduces energy consumption by 55.4% to 70.0% , further boosting overall efficiency. On x86 CPUs, speedups range from 2.37x to 6.17x with energy reductions between 71.9% to 82.2% . Furthermore, bitnet.cpp can run a 100B BitNet b1.58 model on a single CPU, achieving speeds comparable to human reading (5-7 tokens per second), significantly enhancing the potential for running LLMs on local devices. Please refer to the technical report for more details.
paragraphs.zh: bitnet.cpp 在 ARM CPU 上实现了 1.37 倍至 5.07 倍的加速，模型越大性能提升越明显。 此外，它将能耗降低了 55.4% 至 70.0%，进一步提升了整体效率。 在 x86 CPU 上，加速倍数介于 2.37 倍至 6.17 倍之间，能耗降低幅度为 71.9% 至 82.2%。 此外，bitnet.cpp 可以在单个 CPU 上运行 100B 的 BitNet b1.58 模型，速度达到与人类阅读相当的水平（每秒 5-7 个 token），显著增强了在本地设备上运行大语言模型的潜力。 更多细节请参阅技术报告。

sents.en: bitnet.cpp achieves speedups of 1.37x to 5.07x on ARM CPUs, with larger models experiencing greater performance gains.
sents.zh: bitnet.cpp 在 ARM CPU 上实现了 1.37 倍至 5.07 倍的加速，模型越大性能提升越明显。

sents.en: Additionally, it reduces energy consumption by 55.4% to 70.0% , further boosting overall efficiency.
sents.zh: 此外，它将能耗降低了 55.4% 至 70.0%，进一步提升了整体效率。

sents.en: On x86 CPUs, speedups range from 2.37x to 6.17x with energy reductions between 71.9% to 82.2% .
sents.zh: 在 x86 CPU 上，加速倍数介于 2.37 倍至 6.17 倍之间，能耗降低幅度为 71.9% 至 82.2%。

sents.en: Furthermore, bitnet.cpp can run a 100B BitNet b1.58 model on a single CPU, achieving speeds comparable to human reading (5-7 tokens per second), significantly enhancing the potential for running LLMs on local devices.
sents.zh: 此外，bitnet.cpp 可以在单个 CPU 上运行 100B 的 BitNet b1.58 模型，速度达到与人类阅读相当的水平（每秒 5-7 个 token），显著增强了在本地设备上运行大语言模型的潜力。

sents.en: Please refer to the technical report for more details.
sents.zh: 更多细节请参阅技术报告。

paragraphs.en: BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T is the first official BitNet b1.58 model with 2.4B parameters , trained on 4 trillion tokens . It is a ternary (1.58-bit) language model that delivers competitive performance with full-precision models of similar size while enabling significantly faster and more energy-efficient inference.
paragraphs.zh: BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T 是首个官方发布的 2.4B 参数 BitNet b1.58 模型，在 4 万亿个词元上训练而成。 它是一个三值（1.58 比特）语言模型，在性能上可与同规模的全精度模型媲美，同时能够显著加快推理速度并提高能效。

sents.en: BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T is the first official BitNet b1.58 model with 2.4B parameters , trained on 4 trillion tokens .
sents.zh: BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T 是首个官方发布的 2.4B 参数 BitNet b1.58 模型，在 4 万亿个词元上训练而成。

sents.en: It is a ternary (1.58-bit) language model that delivers competitive performance with full-precision models of similar size while enabling significantly faster and more energy-efficient inference.
sents.zh: 它是一个三值（1.58 比特）语言模型，在性能上可与同规模的全精度模型媲美，同时能够显著加快推理速度并提高能效。

paragraphs.en: BitNet-embedding-0.6B is a 0.6B-parameter 1-bit embedding model that achieves competitive embedding quality with significantly faster CPU inference. It is the first model to demonstrate that ternary weights can deliver strong performance on embedding tasks.
paragraphs.zh: BitNet-embedding-0.6B 是一个 0.6B 参数的 1-bit 嵌入模型，在显著加快 CPU 推理速度的同时，实现了具有竞争力的嵌入质量。 它是首个证明三值权重能在嵌入任务上取得出色表现的模型。

sents.en: BitNet-embedding-0.6B is a 0.6B-parameter 1-bit embedding model that achieves competitive embedding quality with significantly faster CPU inference.
sents.zh: BitNet-embedding-0.6B 是一个 0.6B 参数的 1-bit 嵌入模型，在显著加快 CPU 推理速度的同时，实现了具有竞争力的嵌入质量。

sents.en: It is the first model to demonstrate that ternary weights can deliver strong performance on embedding tasks.
sents.zh: 它是首个证明三值权重能在嵌入任务上取得出色表现的模型。

paragraphs.en: BitNet-embedding-270M is a compact 270M-parameter 1-bit embedding model designed for resource-constrained environments, offering fast inference with minimal memory footprint.
paragraphs.zh: BitNet-embedding-270M 是一个紧凑的 270M 参数 1-bit 嵌入模型，专为资源受限的环境设计，能以极小的内存占用实现快速推理。

paragraphs.en: ❗️ We use existing 1-bit LLMs available on Hugging Face to demonstrate the inference capabilities of bitnet.cpp. We hope the release of bitnet.cpp will inspire the development of 1-bit LLMs in large-scale settings in terms of model size and training tokens.
paragraphs.zh: ❗️ 我们使用 Hugging Face 上现有的 1-bit 大语言模型来展示 bitnet.cpp 的推理能力。 我们希望 bitnet.cpp 的发布能够激励在模型规模和训练 token 数量等大规模场景下 1-bit 大语言模型的发展。

paragraphs.en: git clone --recursive https://github.com/microsoft/BitNet.git cd BitNet Install the dependencies # (Recommended) Create a new conda environment conda create -n bitnet-cpp python=3.10 conda activate bitnet-cpp pip install -r requirements.txt Build the project # Manually download the model and run with local path huggingface-cli download microsoft/BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T-gguf --local-dir models/BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T python setup_env.py -md models/BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T -q i2_s usage: setup_env.py [-h] [--hf-repo {1bitLLM/bitnet_b1_58-large,1bitLLM/bitnet_b1_58-3B,HF1BitLLM/Llama3-8B-1.58-100B-tokens,tiiuae/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-3B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-7B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-10B-Instruct-1.58bit}] [--model-dir MODEL_DIR] [--log-dir LOG_DIR] [--quant-type {i2_s,tl1}] [--quant-embd] [--use-pretuned] Setup the environment for running inference optional arguments: -h, --help show this help message and exit --hf-repo {1bitLLM/bitnet_b1_58-large,1bitLLM/bitnet_b1_58-3B,HF1BitLLM/Llama3-8B-1.58-100B-tokens,tiiuae/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-3B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-7B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-10B-Instruct-1.58bit}, -hr {1bitLLM/bitnet_b1_58-large,1bitLLM/bitnet_b1_58-3B,HF1BitLLM/Llama3-8B-1.58-100B-tokens,tiiuae/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-3B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-7B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-10B-Instruct-1.58bit} Model used for inference --model-dir MODEL_DIR, -md MODEL_DIR Directory to save/load the model --log-dir LOG_DIR, -ld LOG_DIR Directory to save the logging info --quant-type {i2_s,tl1}, -q {i2_s,tl1} Quantization type --quant-embd Quantize the embeddings to f16 --use-pretuned, -p Use the pretuned kernel parameters Usage Basic usage # Run inference with the quantized model python run_inference.py -m models/BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T/ggml-model-i2_s.gguf -p " You are a helpful assistant " -cnv usage: run_inference.py [-h] [-m MODEL] [-n N_PREDICT] -p PROMPT [-t THREADS] [-c CTX_SIZE] [-temp TEMPERATURE] [-cnv] Run inference optional arguments: -h, --help show this help message and exit -m MODEL, --model MODEL Path to model file -n N_PREDICT, --n-predict N_PREDICT Number of tokens to predict when generating text -p PROMPT, --prompt PROMPT Prompt to generate text from -t THREADS, --threads THREADS Number of threads to use -c CTX_SIZE, --ctx-size CTX_SIZE Size of the prompt context -temp TEMPERATURE, --temperature TEMPERATURE Temperature, a hyperparameter that controls the r
paragraphs.zh: git clone --recursive https://github.com/microsoft/BitNet.git cd BitNet 安装依赖 # （推荐）创建一个新的 conda 环境 conda create -n bitnet-cpp python=3.10 conda activate bitnet-cpp pip install -r requirements.txt 构建项目 # 手动下载模型并使用本地路径运行 huggingface-cli download microsoft/BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T-gguf --local-dir models/BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T python setup_env.py -md models/BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T -q i2_s 用法：setup_env.py [-h] [--hf-repo {1bitLLM/bitnet_b1_58-large,1bitLLM/bitnet_b1_58-3B,HF1BitLLM/Llama3-8B-1.58-100B-tokens,tiiuae/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-3B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-7B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-10B-Instruct-1.58bit}] [--model-dir MODEL_DIR] [--log-dir LOG_DIR] [--quant-type {i2_s,tl1}] [--quant-embd] [--use-pretuned] 设置运行推理的环境 可选参数： -h, --help 显示此帮助信息并退出 --hf-repo {1bitLLM/bitnet_b1_58-large,1bitLLM/bitnet_b1_58-3B,HF1BitLLM/Llama3-8B-1.58-100B-tokens,tiiuae/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-3B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-7B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-10B-Instruct-1.58bit}, -hr {1bitLLM/bitnet_b1_58-large,1bitLLM/bitnet_b1_58-3B,HF1BitLLM/Llama3-8B-1.58-100B-tokens,tiiuae/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-3B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-7B-Instruct-1.58bit,tiiuae/Falcon3-10B-Instruct-1.58bit} 用于推理的模型 --model-dir MODEL_DIR, -md MODEL_DIR 保存/加载模型的目录 --log-dir LOG_DIR, -ld LOG_DIR 保存日志信息的目录 --quant-type {i2_s,tl1}, -q {i2_s,tl1} 量化类型 --quant-embd 将嵌入（embeddings）量化为 f16 --use-pretuned, -p 使用预调优的内核参数 用法 基本用法 # 使用量化模型运行推理 python run_inference.py -m models/BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T/ggml-model-i2_s.gguf -p " You are a helpful assistant " -cnv 用法：run_inference.py [-h] [-m MODEL] [-n N_PREDICT] -p PROMPT [-t THREADS] [-c CTX_SIZE] [-temp TEMPERATURE] [-cnv] 运行推理 可选参数： -h, --help 显示此帮助信息并退出 -m MODEL, --model MODEL 模型文件路径 -n N_PREDICT, --n-predict N_PREDICT 生成文本时预测的 token 数量 -p PROMPT, --prompt PROMPT 用于生成文本的提示词 -t THREADS, --threads THREADS 使用的线程数 -c CTX_SIZE, --ctx-size CTX_SIZE 提示词上下文的大小 -temp TEMPERATURE, --temperature TEMPERATURE 温度（temperature），控制随机性的超

paragraphs.en: We provide scripts to run the inference benchmark providing a model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供脚本来运行给定模型的推理基准测试。

paragraphs.en: usage: e2e_benchmark.py -m MODEL [-n N_TOKEN] [-p N_PROMPT] [-t THREADS] Setup the environment for running the inference required arguments: -m MODEL, --model MODEL Path to the model file. optional arguments: -h, --help Show this help message and exit. -n N_TOKEN, --n-token N_TOKEN Number of generated tokens. -p N_PROMPT, --n-prompt N_PROMPT Prompt to generate text from. -t THREADS, --threads THREADS Number of threads to use. Here's a brief explanation of each argument:
paragraphs.zh: 用法：e2e_benchmark.py -m MODEL [-n N_TOKEN] [-p N_PROMPT] [-t THREADS] 设置运行推理所需的环境：必需参数：-m MODEL, --model MODEL 模型文件路径。可选参数：-h, --help 显示此帮助信息并退出。-n N_TOKEN, --n-token N_TOKEN 生成的令牌数量。-p N_PROMPT, --n-prompt N_PROMPT 用于生成文本的提示词。-t THREADS, --threads THREADS 使用的线程数量。 以下是每个参数的简要说明：

sents.en: usage: e2e_benchmark.py -m MODEL [-n N_TOKEN] [-p N_PROMPT] [-t THREADS] Setup the environment for running the inference required arguments: -m MODEL, --model MODEL Path to the model file. optional arguments: -h, --help Show this help message and exit. -n N_TOKEN, --n-token N_TOKEN Number of generated tokens. -p N_PROMPT, --n-prompt N_PROMPT Prompt to generate text from. -t THREADS, --threads THREADS Number of threads to use.
sents.zh: 用法：e2e_benchmark.py -m MODEL [-n N_TOKEN] [-p N_PROMPT] [-t THREADS] 设置运行推理所需的环境：必需参数：-m MODEL, --model MODEL 模型文件路径。可选参数：-h, --help 显示此帮助信息并退出。-n N_TOKEN, --n-token N_TOKEN 生成的令牌数量。-p N_PROMPT, --n-prompt N_PROMPT 用于生成文本的提示词。-t THREADS, --threads THREADS 使用的线程数量。

sents.en: Here's a brief explanation of each argument:
sents.zh: 以下是每个参数的简要说明：

paragraphs.en: python utils/e2e_benchmark.py -m /path/to/model -n 200 -p 256 -t 4 This command would run the inference benchmark using the model located at /path/to/model , generating 200 tokens from a 256 token prompt, utilizing 4 threads.
paragraphs.zh: python utils/e2e_benchmark.py -m /path/to/model -n 200 -p 256 -t 4 此命令将使用位于 /path/to/model 的模型运行推理基准测试，从 256 个 token 的提示词生成 200 个 token，并使用 4 个线程。

paragraphs.en: For the model layout that do not supported by any public model, we provide scripts to generate a dummy model with the given model layout, and run the benchmark on your machine:
paragraphs.zh: 对于任何公开模型都不支持的模型布局，我们提供了脚本来生成具有给定模型布局的虚拟模型，并在您的机器上运行基准测试：

paragraphs.en: python utils/generate-dummy-bitnet-model.py models/bitnet_b1_58-large --outfile models/dummy-bitnet-125m.tl1.gguf --outtype tl1 --model-size 125M # Run benchmark with the generated model, use -m to specify the model path, -p to specify the prompt processed, -n to specify the number of token to generate python utils/e2e_benchmark.py -m models/dummy-bitnet-125m.tl1.gguf -p 512 -n 128 Convert from .safetensors Checkpoints # Prepare the .safetensors model file huggingface-cli download microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 --local-dir ./models/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 # Convert to gguf model python ./utils/convert-helper-bitnet.py ./models/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 Acknowledgements This project is based on the llama.cpp framework. We would like to thank all the authors for their contributions to the open-source community. Also, bitnet.cpp's kernels are built on top of the Lookup Table methodologies pioneered in T-MAC . For inference of general low-bit LLMs beyond ternary models, we recommend using T-MAC.
paragraphs.zh: python utils/generate-dummy-bitnet-model.py models/bitnet_b1_58-large --outfile models/dummy-bitnet-125m.tl1.gguf --outtype tl1 --model-size 125M # 使用生成的模型运行基准测试，用 -m 指定模型路径，-p 指定处理的提示词，-n 指定要生成的 token 数量 python utils/e2e_benchmark.py -m models/dummy-bitnet-125m.tl1.gguf -p 512 -n 128 从 .safetensors 检查点转换 # 准备 .safetensors 模型文件 huggingface-cli download microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 --local-dir ./models/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 # 转换为 gguf 模型 python ./utils/convert-helper-bitnet.py ./models/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 致谢 本项目基于 llama.cpp 框架。 我们要感谢所有为开源社区做出贡献的作者。 此外，bitnet.cpp 的内核构建于 T-MAC 中开创的查找表方法之上。 对于三值模型之外的一般低比特大语言模型的推理，我们推荐使用 T-MAC。

sents.en: python utils/generate-dummy-bitnet-model.py models/bitnet_b1_58-large --outfile models/dummy-bitnet-125m.tl1.gguf --outtype tl1 --model-size 125M # Run benchmark with the generated model, use -m to specify the model path, -p to specify the prompt processed, -n to specify the number of token to generate python utils/e2e_benchmark.py -m models/dummy-bitnet-125m.tl1.gguf -p 512 -n 128 Convert from .safetensors Checkpoints # Prepare the .safetensors model file huggingface-cli download microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 --local-dir ./models/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 # Convert to gguf model python ./utils/convert-helper-bitnet.py ./models/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 Acknowledgements This project is based on the llama.cpp framework.
sents.zh: python utils/generate-dummy-bitnet-model.py models/bitnet_b1_58-large --outfile models/dummy-bitnet-125m.tl1.gguf --outtype tl1 --model-size 125M # 使用生成的模型运行基准测试，用 -m 指定模型路径，-p 指定处理的提示词，-n 指定要生成的 token 数量 python utils/e2e_benchmark.py -m models/dummy-bitnet-125m.tl1.gguf -p 512 -n 128 从 .safetensors 检查点转换 # 准备 .safetensors 模型文件 huggingface-cli download microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 --local-dir ./models/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 # 转换为 gguf 模型 python ./utils/convert-helper-bitnet.py ./models/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 致谢 本项目基于 llama.cpp 框架。

sents.en: We would like to thank all the authors for their contributions to the open-source community.
sents.zh: 我们要感谢所有为开源社区做出贡献的作者。

sents.en: Also, bitnet.cpp's kernels are built on top of the Lookup Table methodologies pioneered in T-MAC .
sents.zh: 此外，bitnet.cpp 的内核构建于 T-MAC 中开创的查找表方法之上。

sents.en: For inference of general low-bit LLMs beyond ternary models, we recommend using T-MAC.
sents.zh: 对于三值模型之外的一般低比特大语言模型的推理，我们推荐使用 T-MAC。

paragraphs.en: A: Before building the project, verify your clang installation and access to Visual Studio tools by running:
paragraphs.zh: A: 在构建项目之前，请先运行以下命令，验证你的 clang 安装以及对 Visual Studio 工具的访问权限：

paragraphs.en: clang -v This command checks that you are using the correct version of clang and that the Visual Studio tools are available. If you see an error message such as:
paragraphs.zh: clang -v 此命令用于检查你是否在使用正确版本的 clang，以及 Visual Studio 工具是否可用。 如果你看到类似如下的错误消息：

sents.en: clang -v This command checks that you are using the correct version of clang and that the Visual Studio tools are available.
sents.zh: clang -v 此命令用于检查你是否在使用正确版本的 clang，以及 Visual Studio 工具是否可用。

sents.en: If you see an error message such as:
sents.zh: 如果你看到类似如下的错误消息：

paragraphs.en: 'clang' is not recognized as an internal or external command, operable program or batch file. It indicates that your command line window is not properly initialized for Visual Studio tools.
paragraphs.zh: “clang”不是内部或外部命令，也不是可运行的程序或批处理文件。 这表明你的命令行窗口未针对 Visual Studio 工具正确初始化。

sents.en: 'clang' is not recognized as an internal or external command, operable program or batch file.
sents.zh: “clang”不是内部或外部命令，也不是可运行的程序或批处理文件。

sents.en: It indicates that your command line window is not properly initialized for Visual Studio tools.
sents.zh: 这表明你的命令行窗口未针对 Visual Studio 工具正确初始化。

paragraphs.en: "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Professional\Common7\Tools\VsDevCmd.bat" -startdir=none -arch=x64 -host_arch=x64 • If you are using Windows PowerShell, run the following commands:
paragraphs.zh: "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Professional\Common7\Tools\VsDevCmd.bat" -startdir=none -arch=x64 -host_arch=x64 • 如果您使用的是 Windows PowerShell，请运行以下命令：

paragraphs.en: Import-Module "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Professional\Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll" Enter-VsDevShell 3f0e31ad -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments "-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64" These steps will initialize your environment and allow you to use the correct Visual Studio tools.
paragraphs.zh: Import-Module "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Professional\Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll" Enter-VsDevShell 3f0e31ad -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments "-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64" 这些步骤将初始化你的环境，并允许你使用正确的 Visual Studio 工具。
